pages.text: Health 100, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Attack 15, Speed 0.25.$(br)The villagers' hero and their village's guardian: those arms and that price made it impossible not to wonder how to build your own iron guard. After some effort, you did.
Finally cap it with a $(l)Vitality Carved Pumpkin$().
You can build these loyal guards, or call one quickly with an $(l:supreme/items/iron_guard_focus)Ironguard Focus$().$(br)You can use an $(item)Iron Ingot$() on your Iron Golem Servant to heal it.
